title: GHZ
description: GHZ state preparation and verification benchmark. Constructs a GHZ state on the device using a binary dissemination tree over the device connectivity, then estimates fidelity via direct fidelity estimation (DFE, uniform stabilizer sampling), the two-setting Z/X lower bound, parity oscillation curve fitting, or compressed sensing (random-phase parity sampling with sparse spectrum recovery by L1 minimization).

benchmark_name.description: Name of the benchmark. Must be 'GHZ' for this schema.

num_qubits.description: Number of data qubits for the GHZ state. Required unless size_search is true, in which case it is ignored and the sizes come from the device.

size_search.description: Search GHZ sizes by progressive bisection instead of verifying one fixed size: build GHZ states at halving sizes from the device size down to min_qubits (e.g. 156, 78, 39, 19, 9), dispatch them all in a single job, and report the largest size whose fidelity clears fidelity_threshold (largest_passing_size, which becomes the score) plus per-size fidelities. With the default compressed sensing this costs about 5*ln(N) circuits per size.

min_qubits.description: Lower bound for size_search; halving stops before going below this size. Ignored in fixed-size mode.

fidelity_threshold.description: Fidelity a searched size must exceed to count as passing in size_search. Ignored in fixed-size mode.

shots.description: Number of measurement shots per circuit.

method.description: Verification method: 'dfe' (Flammia-Liu direct fidelity estimation: 1 + num_stabilizers circuits, uniformly sampled off-diagonal stabilizers averaged into an unbiased coherence estimate with pure finite-sampling error), 'two_setting_bound' (2 circuits; the global X parity is corrected by the largest possible non-GHZ complementary-pair contribution estimated from the Z distribution, a conservative lower bound only valid while 2^N stays within the shot count), 'parity_oscillation' (uniform grid over [0, 2pi), needs more than 2N points to avoid aliasing), or 'compressed_sensing' (~5*ln(N) random phases, LASSO over a cosine basis; also witnesses the actual GHZ size and phase offset). When omitted, defaults to 'dfe' for a fixed size and 'compressed_sensing' for size_search.

num_phases.description: Number of phase points for the oscillation-style methods. Ignored for dfe and two_setting_bound. parity_oscillation defaults to max(20, 2N+1) and rejects values at or below 2N, which alias; compressed_sensing defaults to ceil(5*ln(N)), at least 6.

num_stabilizers.description: Number of off-diagonal stabilizers sampled by dfe (one circuit each, plus the shared Z circuit). The required count is O(1/eps^2), independent of N. Ignored by other methods.

seed.description: Seed for the random draws used by compressed_sensing (phases) and dfe (stabilizer sample), for reproducible dispatches. Ignored by other methods.

confidence_sigma.description: Size search only: how many standard deviations a size's fidelity must clear fidelity_threshold by before it counts as passing. Keeps the discrete size score from flipping between runs when a size sits at the boundary. Set to 0 to threshold on the point estimate.
